craft_notes: Sthāyin: beholding-joy (she rests — the verse's crown). Sanskrit first: agency (she pierces, in order), tempo (each moment), fruit (she rests, supreme) → L4 sets agency+tempo line 1, fruit line 2. Rows: row 3 (each-moment kept as 'each breath of time' — distributive preserved). Rupture: semicolon after 'time' — piercing done, resting begins. Close: colon landing on the supreme epithet (crowning). Minimal pass: 'breath of time' for pratikṣaṇam (breath-time singable, moment-doctrine kept). Read aloud: line 1 moves (pierces/order/each), semicolon, line 2 stills (rests/sublime long). Rejected: 'every instant' flat — killed: breath-time breathes; 'she relaxes' — killed: viśramet is solemn rest, sublime kept.

lines: She pierces in her order, wheel in wheel, each breath of time;
she rests, the Great Goddess: the wheel-rest sublime.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vedhayantī kramāc chaktiścakre cakre pratikṣaṇam / viśramet sā mahādevī cakraviśrāma uttamaḥ

reads_against.argmap: She pierces in order and rests in every wheel, each moment — that rest is supreme.
c1_essence: She pierces in order, rests wheel by wheel each moment — supreme wheel-rest.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta strained toward bhayānaka (wonder edged with fear)
